name: DIS3 exosome endoribonuclease and 3'-5' exoribonuclease

function.text: DIS3 encodes exosome complex exonuclease RRP44. Annotated molecular activities include endonuclease activity and 3'-5'-RNA exonuclease activity. It participates in RNA processing and rRNA processing.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Plasma Cell Myeloma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
